build_image_processor: build an EfficientLoFTRImageProcessor instance with configurable grayscale and resize settings
preprocess_image_pairs: preprocess pairs of images into resized, rescaled, grayscale tensors for EfficientLoFTR keypoint matching
post_process_keypoint_matching: post-process EfficientLoFTR keypoint matching outputs into filtered keypoints with original image coordinates
visualize_keypoint_matching: visualize paired images with detected keypoints and matching lines colored by match score
validate_image_pairs: validate and format image pairs as PIL images or 3D arrays for EfficientLoFTR image processing
